definitions.explanation: A color between red and blue.
A slang term for soy sauce, especially at sushi restaurants.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{紫|むらさき}⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古来|こらい}→古来：10168_korai⟧、{紫|むらさき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高貴|こうき}な→高貴：10167_kouki⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されてきた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, purple has traditionally been considered a noble color.

{紫|むらさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

examples.english: At sushi restaurants, soy sauce is called 'murasaki'.

notes:
{紫|むらさき} is the color purple. In traditional Japan, purple was associated with nobility and high rank.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {紫|むらさき}⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: purple color
- ⟦{紫外線|しがいせん}→紫外線：07375_shigaisen⟧: ultraviolet rays
- ⟦{紫陽花|あじさい}→紫陽花：04997_ajisai⟧: hydrangea (written with 紫)

SUSHI RESTAURANT SLANG:
{紫|むらさき} is used to mean 'soy sauce' at sushi restaurants, along with other special terms like:
- {紫|むらさき}: soy sauce
- ⟦あがり→上がり：25038_agari⟧: green tea
- ⟦シャリ→しゃり：15383_shari⟧: sushi rice
- ⟦ガリ→ガリ：27408_gari⟧: pickled ginger

HISTORICAL NOTE:
Purple dye was expensive and difficult to produce, so {紫|むらさき} became associated with royalty and high status in Japan.
